![What is a Prenup? 5 Important Things to Know | KMJ Solicitors](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11152235-2247-0139-0000-c3e86094e4ab:5)
A **prenuptial agreement** (prenup) is `a written legal contract created and signed by a couple before marriage or a civil union` . It outlines how assets, debts, property, income, and spousal support will be handled if the marriage ends in divorce or death, overriding default state laws.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXJy8HgCjLnqJrezdGCOovFJsz5Effffbn3MZkJS60nFwX7HPozUc9Li16PQkicEtReLbN2B2cgsnJsme9ihH5EmObXOLLFQF0GLGRkNYUsjRbBvE-v4Y98RNygLSPnZe6L24vD4IZTCVg4w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXYnhZBXyzboV4YTkeL1Me0Us3TgpSeln0fs_bLVDv47Nk6rCkLAKiS9x0c35EvPqfPNEnPofXBN9tapnq0cta2J_UJb2wKSCF0h3KukSekSDq5-VyR2kWPOu40jv-Ds7cSSFmHp0nApRJLJk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wo4KxPOk7SdsXJAWyCyqKu8nIEwO2C3ArRo8kNEsCxHfUUMXqBzcd1Wci6s1ZAQ6G8TR4cuaM4Z7xKvgm2oRDt4-JkCI3TaK1UC6xbTy1O8cHXKStHo9BMeujxnpRDG3T8p_CHrUCyt25WZ-638XU6lnhhnK8Tt54ZsbY27dLh3)

### What a Prenup Covers

- **Asset and Property Division:** Clarifies what is considered separate property (owned individually before or during the marriage) versus marital/community property.
- **Debts and Liabilities:** Determines who is responsible for pre-existing or future debts (such as student loans or credit cards).
- **Spousal Support (Alimony):** Can set, limit, or waive alimony requirements, provided the terms are fair.
- **Estate Rights:** Outlines inheritances, death provisions, and what a surviving spouse receives if one partner dies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXtpWjDLCiCBP8k0bQ6017O1Z11C7aO_Q5iN6z0NGJDN-G-bQEusu7SHBTVV7Bs0EmAaGpNDSFEBfxxmk9o-RzRMMheBKCommPq2BPacsb6RxI_DeQCIBNtFs_vWBSQ2cL3f-DpojG5w2uNia1O84N9mDI_Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wo4KxPOk7SdsXJAWyCyqKu8nIEwO2C3ArRo8kNEsCxHfUUMXqBzcd1Wci6s1ZAQ6G8TR4cuaM4Z7xKvgm2oRDt4-JkCI3TaK1UC6xbTy1O8cHXKStHo9BMeujxnpRDG3T8p_CHrUCyt25WZ-638XU6lnhhnK8Tt54ZsbY27dLh3)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF18dSDxov0liEwy30I6ptmGmRYH3d1EwmQWMPQk4XflJnXwVYwwvtZDeuwqEQ5TzOIJAfFRwOi9lBWl05BvT1K1_SjB8M7ks62RRhO6y0g-rgMtcf30YQyR8r3AEDyYf0LSRJohBrTIXpD92iYhnAC7Wdbzqq24y-oy0or7A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXYnhZBXyzboV4YTkeL1Me0Us3TgpSeln0fs_bLVDv47Nk6rCkLAKiS9x0c35EvPqfPNEnPofXBN9tapnq0cta2J_UJb2wKSCF0h3KukSekSDq5-VyR2kWPOu40jv-Ds7cSSFmHp0nApRJLJk)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXXiFPUAUUosYEyE3HfUV32oe_MBWXeM_QQxFdsGuodW3kuDQpIMVkuk-CwnwYO3seVPsROgXRh1fqX1CQghGC2YeYX34UVlHlTbzXx-F8jpd3QFxo2Xv3FKdJp67V1pHTJr0)

### What a Prenup Cannot Cover

- **Child Custody and Visitation:** Courts decide custody based on the child's best interests at the time of a split, so you cannot pre-negotiate this.
- **Child Support:** You cannot waive or reduce future child support obligations.
- **Illegal or Unenforceable Terms:** Clauses that violate public policy, personal lifestyle rules, or encourage divorce are void.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXYnhZBXyzboV4YTkeL1Me0Us3TgpSeln0fs_bLVDv47Nk6rCkLAKiS9x0c35EvPqfPNEnPofXBN9tapnq0cta2J_UJb2wKSCF0h3KukSekSDq5-VyR2kWPOu40jv-Ds7cSSFmHp0nApRJLJk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXJy8HgCjLnqJrezdGCOovFJsz5Effffbn3MZkJS60nFwX7HPozUc9Li16PQkicEtReLbN2B2cgsnJsme9ihH5EmObXOLLFQF0GLGRkNYUsjRbBvE-v4Y98RNygLSPnZe6L24vD4IZTCVg4w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXiMi-LRNRAKHXo5oNWP8pZLLVsDiVCDJgzxRBMT_OvsAzYE5dF_lpgA7GHfCvJg7_gtXDH0KvdUc9lH_wBn00tHljuDAf1sB06v0TjpT_QWm6Sga0iH1hid0AhYZ1p8HTAW--)

### Key Requirements for a Valid Prenup

- **Written & Voluntary:** Must be put into writing and signed freely without coercion, fraud, or duress.
- **Full Financial Disclosure:** Both partners must transparently share all assets, debts, and income.
- **Independent Legal Counsel:** Each partner should ideally have their own separate family law attorney to review the agreement and prevent conflicts of interest.
- **Timing:** It should be started and signed well ahead of the wedding—typically 6 to 12 months prior—to avoid last-minute pressure claims.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_O-5Cm-S_YLK87cfezb7JBtQvFZJrsvHT2neY0bPHuTeW9O4WArA-cqUPY5rZzI4tSoTqfAHvbZgiyXfb-Y_bvmavMfc5rMoKkeKoRd5zIzqxM0zdpCJugc0_dO5jC34kjp2MtOwAnZNOsDkaAktCPFgRiZ1eUyTYKp3ZmOzGr42xi1US4f_GqomIOz)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wo4KxPOk7SdsXJAWyCyqKu8nIEwO2C3ArRo8kNEsCxHfUUMXqBzcd1Wci6s1ZAQ6G8TR4cuaM4Z7xKvgm2oRDt4-JkCI3TaK1UC6xbTy1O8cHXKStHo9BMeujxnpRDG3T8p_CHrUCyt25WZ-638XU6lnhhnK8Tt54ZsbY27dLh3)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXtpWjDLCiCBP8k0bQ6017O1Z11C7aO_Q5iN6z0NGJDN-G-bQEusu7SHBTVV7Bs0EmAaGpNDSFEBfxxmk9o-RzRMMheBKCommPq2BPacsb6RxI_DeQCIBNtFs_vWBSQ2cL3f-DpojG5w2uNia1O84N9mDI_Q)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXiMi-LRNRAKHXo5oNWP8pZLLVsDiVCDJgzxRBMT_OvsAzYE5dF_lpgA7GHfCvJg7_gtXDH0KvdUc9lH_wBn00tHljuDAf1sB06v0TjpT_QWm6Sga0iH1hid0AhYZ1p8HTAW--)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1y_xGjajUeUapcCzFR21Pn31gSnTR8q37HqcQumAeW7o7mjxBzRaTq7hj1ScNu1yTivM3CAkRcWawGJ2h6AxTeJW_XeHEcBvpEvGueGKHfQvRdl4aaLSK1ZiQk0D18yory5PtaC95fHMtgXvQfg1dIWPK_mf10mr6f8kjCrzio3EKRnz)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXiIn295BF76aO9xUZzd3frvWL7HSQDr9SGEJd7bze-Fzyr5ou4yNRzXOjPS5aXJfYAYbBh5QTKTxxODwXeTl5MVnaOVS12_CuY9_7Z0wIDFxu_w8fN2gMbhIbSzjcpr69Y-F3O0mEl0LX)

You can read more about planning and execution guidelines via [Fidelity Investments](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_O-5Cm-S_YLK87cfezb7JBtQvFZJrsvHT2neY0bPHuTeW9O4WArA-cqUPY5rZzI4tSoTqfAHvbZgiyXfb-Y_bvmavMfc5rMoKkeKoRd5zIzqxM0zdpCJugc0_dO5jC34kjp2MtOwAnZNOsDkaAktCPFgRiZ1eUyTYKp3ZmOzGr42xi1US4f_GqomIOz) or review general statutory concepts on [Wikipedia](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXJy8HgCjLnqJrezdGCOovFJsz5Effffbn3MZkJS60nFwX7HPozUc9Li16PQkicEtReLbN2B2cgsnJsme9ihH5EmObXOLLFQF0GLGRkNYUsjRbBvE-v4Y98RNygLSPnZe6L24vD4IZTCVg4w).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1_O-5Cm-S_YLK87cfezb7JBtQvFZJrsvHT2neY0bPHuTeW9O4WArA-cqUPY5rZzI4tSoTqfAHvbZgiyXfb-Y_bvmavMfc5rMoKkeKoRd5zIzqxM0zdpCJugc0_dO5jC34kjp2MtOwAnZNOsDkaAktCPFgRiZ1eUyTYKp3ZmOzGr42xi1US4f_GqomIOz)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXJy8HgCjLnqJrezdGCOovFJsz5Effffbn3MZkJS60nFwX7HPozUc9Li16PQkicEtReLbN2B2cgsnJsme9ihH5EmObXOLLFQF0GLGRkNYUsjRbBvE-v4Y98RNygLSPnZe6L24vD4IZTCVg4w)If you are looking for specific guidance, tell me:

expanded_element.snippet: Potential for Unequal Terms While prenuptial agreements offer many benefits, they also have potential drawbacks. One of these is the risk of unequal terms.
